name: ECMO
blurb: Veno-venous and veno-arterial support: physiology, candidacy, the service, and the decisions that are harder than the cannulation.
intro: Start with the physiology episode, then the service episode, then the decision-making one. The echo-for-ECMO material sits under Mechanical support.

name: Mechanical circulatory support
blurb: Balloon pumps, VA-ECMO, VADs and the Impella — what each does, how to read it, and what goes wrong.
intro: The unit view first, then the balloon pump in depth, then the two-part echo guide to every device.

name: Bleeding and haemostasis
blurb: Products, point-of-care tests, protamine, heparin resistance and HIT — the unit half and the theatre half.
intro: Two companion episodes recorded in the same week, plus the ITACS journal club on anaemia before surgery.

name: Cardiopulmonary bypass and theatre
blurb: The circuit and what it does to the patient, vasoplegia, SAM, pacing, and the airway problems specific to cardiothoracics.
intro: The bypass episode underpins almost everything else in the catalogue.

name: Valves and structural heart
blurb: Aortic stenosis on the unit, TAVI in the cath lab, and endocarditis from diagnosis to theatre.
intro: Each subject is a companion pair: the intensive care half and the theatre or cath-lab half.

name: Aortic emergencies
blurb: Hypertensive emergencies, dissection, and deep hypothermic circulatory arrest.
intro: The ICU half on recognition and anti-impulse therapy, then the theatre half on operating when you can't clamp.

name: Heart and lung transplantation
blurb: The twelve hours in theatre and the first forty-eight on the unit.
intro: Almost everything in both episodes comes back to the right ventricle.
